metric_definitions.embedding_collapse_score: (mean off-diagonal cosine + 1)/2, sampled without replacement with seed 42. Measures directional alignment, not recommendation diversity.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean positive-minus-negative raw score at the ORIGINAL final occupied position; neither empty rows nor invalid candidate pairs are included.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_p10: Nearest-rank tenth percentile of these margins.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction of these margins below zero.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction of these margins below 0.5; score-scale dependent.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_category_breakdown: Category lists are empty because item category metadata is unavailable.
metric_definitions.protocol: Up to ten identical cached loader batches, fixed input width, candidates, checkpoint, and original readout. Lag zero is never edited. Recent lags 1-5; old lags >=16; random controls sample all occupied positive lags. m=min(3,recent count,old count). Three draws with local seed 42 share positions across replacement types. These defaults are prespecified, not established optima.
metric_definitions.interventions: ID0 changes the model's padding/position mask. Zero-item-embedding uses a temporary lookup-output hook and preserves original IDs, positional embeddings, and padding masks. These interventions are not equivalent. Frequency replacements use training-interaction frequency quintiles, keep ties together, exclude original IDs, observed training items and candidates, and abstain jointly across bands for each row/draw if any required substitution is unavailable. No predictor is fitted.
metric_definitions.intervention_margin_deltas: Edited minus intact positive-minus-negative margin. Repeated draws and repeated sampled rows are averaged within uniquely identified training user IDs before aggregation. Ambiguous suffix-to-user matches are excluded. Old-minus-random is paired within the same row and draw. Positive values mean old replacement increases the margin more than random replacement. User identification uses the sampler's truncated training prefix plus its aligned final positive. Strata use occupied input length, truncated by input width. Missing length-stratum results are explicit; old-lag eligibility requires at least 17 occupied positions for contiguous left-padded histories.
metric_definitions.uncertainty: 2,000 paired user bootstrap replicates with seed 42, percentile 95% intervals within this category only. Length strata are 1-5,6-15,16-31,32+. Intervals condition on checkpoint, supplied negatives, cached histories and replacement draws; they exclude training and adaptive-search uncertainty. Users are the sampling units, never replacement draws. Overall training intervals use an unstratified user bootstrap; length-specific intervals resample within each reported stratum. They are not the proposed stratified four-category validation bootstrap. No macro validation interval is inferred.
metric_definitions.primary_contrast: frequency_matched/old_minus_random is prespecified. Recent, ID0, zero-item-embedding and stratum results are controls or exploratory, without multiple-comparison guarantees.
metric_definitions.locality: Structural candidate span sums longest convolutional increments across residual blocks, including both convolutions and the longest gated branch. It is not certified: functional paths and dilation holes require a complete dependency audit. Outside-field invariance is explicitly unavailable until then. Padding norms are observations at block outputs on a bounded batch; no clamping intervention is performed.
metric_definitions.scope: Training sensitivity only; not validation ranking performance, user intent, compatibility, satisfaction, or simulator traits. Selection remains pinned host macro HR@10. No training, architecture, checkpoint, predictor, routing, or data changes are made.
